git log --format="%s" v1.0.0..HEAD
touch CHANGELOG.md
sed -i '1i ## [1.1.0] - 2023-10-27' CHANGELOG.md

python -m ruff check .
python -m ruff format --check .
python -m mypy .

cards.title: Run concurrent index migration in staging
cards.when: You need to add a database index to a staging environment without locking the table.
cards.cmds:
psql -c 'CREATE INDEX CONCURRENTLY idx_users_email ON users (email)'
psql -c 'SELECT indexrelid::regclass FROM pg_index WHERE NOT indisvalid'
psql -c '\d users'

cards.title: Declare security incident with evidence snapshot
cards.when: When a security event is in progress and requires immediate evidence preservation before mitigation.
cards.cmds:
sampo capture --incident 'security event detected' --signal CMD
mkdir -p /tmp/incident_evidence
cp /var/log/access.log /tmp/incident_evidence/access.log
sha256sum /tmp/incident_evidence/access.log

cards.title: Triage security incident severity and impact
cards.when: After declaring the incident, to determine the severity level and affected users.
cards.cmds:
grep -c 'status 500' /var/log/access.log
awk '{if(!seen[$1]++) count++} END{print count}' /var/log/access.log
date -u +%Y-%m-%dT%H:%M:%SZ
sampo capture --incident severity 'Severity: High, Affected IPs: 5' --expect 'record includes count'

cards.title: Mitigate security incident by blocking bad traffic
cards.when: When the incident is active and reversible mitigation is needed to stop harm.
cards.cmds:
sampo capture --incident blocklist '192.168.1.100' --expect 'IP is recorded'
bash -c 'iptables -I INPUT -s 192.168.1.100 -j DROP'
sampo capture --incident log 'block IP 192.168.1.100' --expect 'no new requests from IP'
awk '/192.168.1.100/{last=$0} END{print last}' /var/log/access.log

cards.title: Verify evidence integrity in security incident
cards.when: After preserving evidence, to ensure the logs have not been tampered with.
cards.cmds:
sha256sum /tmp/incident_evidence/access.log
sha256sum -c /tmp/incident_evidence/access.log.sha256
stat -c %y /tmp/incident_evidence/access.log
sampo capture --incident verification 'Evidence integrity verified' --expect 'checksum matches and mtime unchanged'

rg -n @media src/styles
cat src/styles/nav.css
sed -i 's/class="nav-link"/class="hidden md:block"/' src/components/Nav.tsx
npm run build
rg -n nav-link src/components/Nav.tsx

cards.title: Run release C benchmark without debug
cards.when: Use when validating a C performance change before release.
cards.cmds:
make release_bench
cc -O3 -DNDEBUG -o bench_bench release_bench.c -lm
sh run_bench.sh
cat bench_baseline.txt

cards.title: Compare release before and after code change
cards.when: Use when a C code change claims to improve runtime before release.
cards.cmds:
make baseline_release
make candidate_release
sh compare_release.sh
cat release_delta.txt

cards.title: Find hot C functions in release build
cards.when: Use when C code is too slow and you need the slowest functions.
cards.cmds:
make release_profile
sh run_profile_workload.sh
head -20 profile_release.txt
grep -c hot_loop src/hot_loop.c

cards.title: Use fixed buffers in release C hot loops
cards.when: Use when a C hot loop allocates small buffers on every call.
cards.cmds:
grep -c malloc src/perf.c
cc -O3 -DNDEBUG -c src/perf.c -o /dev/null
sh run_bench.sh
cat bench_new.txt

cards.title: Load SQLite Schema Refactor Into Scratch
cards.when: Use it when a SQLite schema refactor must prove it loads before docs are published.
cards.cmds:
touch scratch.db
sqlite3 scratch.db .read schema.sql
sqlite3 scratch.db .tables
sqlite3 scratch.db ".schema orders"
echo schema-ok

cards.title: Run PostgreSQL Refactor Script With Error Stop
cards.when: Use it when a scratch database named scratch exists and a PostgreSQL refactor must stop at the first failing statement.
cards.cmds:
cat migration.sql
psql -d scratch -v ON_ERROR_STOP=1 -f migration.sql
psql -d scratch -c 'SELECT count(*) FROM orders'
echo migration-ok

cards.title: Review SQL Refactor Diff Then Execute Script
cards.when: Use it when a SQL refactor changes schema files and the docs need a safe execution path.
cards.cmds:
git diff --unified=3 -- schema.sql
psql -d scratch -v ON_ERROR_STOP=1 -f migration.sql
psql -d scratch -c "SELECT column_name FROM information_schema.columns WHERE table_name = 'orders' AND column_name = 'status'"
echo refactor-verified

cards.title: Capture Index Plan For Refactored Query
cards.when: Use it when a SQL refactor adds an index and docs must prove the query uses it.
cards.cmds:
psql -d scratch -f seed.sql
psql -d scratch -o plan.txt -c "EXPLAIN (ANALYZE, BUFFERS) SELECT * FROM orders WHERE status = 'paid'"
grep -n "idx_orders_status" plan.txt
cat plan.txt

cards.title: Find planning playbook file in docs
cards.when: Use this when the model needs to confirm where the planning playbook is stored before writing a plan.
cards.cmds:
find references -name 'planner.md'
ls references/plan
rg 'Playbook' references/plan/planner.md

cards.title: Extract planner headings from docs
cards.when: Use this when the model needs the required plan headings before drafting a document.
cards.cmds:
rg '^#{1,3} ' references/plan/planner.md
rg 'Plan Format' references/plan/planner.md
tail -n 80 references/plan/planner.md

cards.title: Build plan phases from docs templates
cards.when: Use this when the model turns a feature request into phased plan steps from docs.
cards.cmds:
rg 'Step Name' references/plan/planner.md
rg 'Phase 1' references/plan/planner.md
find . -name '*.md'
rg 'auth' docs

cards.title: Check plan doc against playbook format
cards.when: Use this when the model finishes a plan document and must verify required sections.
cards.cmds:
rg '## Overview' plan.md
rg '## Requirements' plan.md
rg '## Architecture Changes' plan.md
rg '## Implementation Steps' plan.md
wc -l plan.md

cards.title: Extract Mobile Crash Marker From Log
cards.when: Use when a phone app crash is reported and a saved log file contains the crash output.
cards.cmds:
cd /var/mobile/logs
rg -n --color=never FATAL /var/mobile/logs/crash.log
tail -n 50 /var/mobile/logs/crash.log

cards.title: Confirm Release Build Type Before Reproducing
cards.when: Use when a phone crash only happens in a production-like build and you must confirm the build type before testing.
cards.cmds:
cd /workspace/app
rg -n -i --color=never release /workspace/app
cat /workspace/app/package.json

cards.title: Run TypeScript And Jest After Crash Fix
cards.when: Use when a JavaScript or React Native crash fix has been made and the package uses TypeScript and Jest.
cards.cmds:
cd /workspace/app
npx tsc --noEmit
npx jest --ci

cards.title: Confirm Crash Marker Absent In New Log
cards.when: Use when a release build has been rebuilt and a new device log file has been captured after the fix.
cards.cmds:
cd /var/mobile/logs
rg -c --color=never FATAL /var/mobile/logs/crash-old.log
rg -c --color=never FATAL /var/mobile/logs/crash-new.log
wc -l /var/mobile/logs/crash-old.log /var/mobile/logs/crash-new.log

cards.title: Capture C header design facts into notes
cards.when: Use when a C module design must be recorded before editing implementation.
cards.cmds:
find src -name "*.h"
rg -n int src
rg -n own docs/design.md

cards.title: Capture C design drift between code and docs
cards.when: Use when C implementation may have changed and the design note may be stale.
cards.cmds:
git diff --name-only HEAD~1
rg -n int src
rg -n safe_copy docs/design.md

cards.title: Capture C test design for boundary behavior
cards.when: Use when designing tests for a C function with buffer or pointer boundaries.
cards.cmds:
head -n 80 src/copy.h
rg -n assert tests
cc -std=c11 -Wall -Wextra -Werror -c tests/test_copy.c -o /dev/null

cards.title: Capture C design invariants for shared data
cards.when: Use when C functions share buffers, counters, or pointers across calls.
cards.cmds:
rg -n int src
rg -n memcpy src
rg -n invariant docs/design.md

cards.title: Find first mobile build error in logs
cards.when: Use when an iOS or Android mobile build fails and the failure layer is unknown.
cards.cmds:
ls -la build/ios build/android
find build/ios build/android -name '*.log' -type f
tail -40 build/ios/Build.log
grep -n error build/ios/Build.log

cards.title: Check mobile dependency lockfile drift
cards.when: Use when a mobile build fails after dependency changes and the lockfile may be wrong.
cards.cmds:
git status --short
git diff --stat
git diff --name-only
git diff package-lock.json

cards.title: Inspect mobile code signing environment
cards.when: Use when a release mobile build fails with no profiles or code signing errors.
cards.cmds:
env
stat build/ios/Profile.mobileprovision
file build/ios/Profile.mobileprovision
grep -a -m 1 TeamID build/ios/Profile.mobileprovision

cards.title: Prove shared mobile fix on both platforms
cards.when: Use when shared code changes may build on one mobile platform and break the other.
cards.cmds:
git diff --name-only
npm run build:ios
npm run build:android
git diff --stat

cards.title: Check every shipped version string
cards.when: Use it when a plugin version is about to be tagged and multiple manifest files may carry version fields.
cards.cmds:
grep -rn "version" .claude-plugin plugin/.claude-plugin
jq -r .version .claude-plugin/marketplace.json
jq -r .version plugin/.claude-plugin/plugin.json

cards.title: Validate plugin manifest and marketplace catalog
cards.when: Use it when the release tree must contain parseable JSON manifests before any tag is created.
cards.cmds:
python3 -m json.tool .claude-plugin/marketplace.json
python3 -m json.tool plugin/.claude-plugin/plugin.json
find .claude-plugin plugin/.claude-plugin -name "*.json" -print

cards.title: Run the release test suite before tagging
cards.when: Use it when the exact tree to be tagged must prove its test suite passes.
cards.cmds:
ls tests
python3 -m unittest discover -s tests -t tests
find tests -name "test_*.py" -print

cards.title: Create a patch tag after release gates
cards.when: Use it when validation and tests pass and the release needs a new tag without moving a published tag.
cards.cmds:
git tag --list v1.2.3
grep -n "1.2.3" CHANGELOG.md
git tag -a v1.2.3 -m "Release 1.2.3"
git tag --list v1.2.3

cards.title: Verify one C file compiles clean
cards.when: Use before changing a C project to confirm the baseline build is warning-free.
cards.cmds:
ls src
cc -std=c11 -Wall -Wextra -Werror -c src/foo.c -o /dev/null
make test

cards.title: Run C tests with memory sanitizers
cards.when: Use when a C change may introduce overflow, use-after-free, or undefined behavior.
cards.cmds:
cc -g -std=c11 -Wall -Wextra -fno-omit-frame-pointer -fsanitize=address,undefined src/test_copy.c src/copy.c -o test_copy_san
bash -c ./test_copy_san

cards.title: Find a failed Postgres index build
cards.when: Use after a concurrent index build to detect an unfinished or failed index.
cards.cmds:
psql -d app_dev -c "SELECT 1"
psql -d app_dev -c "SELECT indexrelid::regclass FROM pg_index WHERE NOT indisvalid"
psql -d app_dev -c "EXPLAIN (ANALYZE, BUFFERS) SELECT id FROM orders WHERE user_id = 42"

cards.title: Prove a C rewrite outputs identical files
cards.when: Use after refactoring C code that writes text report files.
cards.cmds:
wc -l baseline.txt new.txt
diff baseline.txt new.txt
sha256sum baseline.txt new.txt

cards.title: Review schema design for destructive migrations
cards.when: Use this when approving a SQL migration that may remove live data or structure.
cards.cmds:
find . -name '*.sql' -type f
rg -n 'DROP TABLE' .
rg -n 'ALTER TABLE' .

cards.title: Review query design for input safety
cards.when: Use this when reviewing a query that can be reached with request-controlled values.
cards.cmds:
rg -n 'execute' .
rg -n 'WHERE email =' .

cards.title: Review index design for query plans
cards.when: Use this when reviewing a schema change that adds an index for a filtered query.
cards.cmds:
rg -n 'CREATE INDEX' .
rg -n 'WHERE email =' .
sqlite3 scratch.sqlite "EXPLAIN QUERY PLAN SELECT id FROM users WHERE email = 'a@x.io'"

cards.title: Review join design for null semantics
cards.when: Use this when reviewing SQL that joins or filters rows with nullable columns.
cards.cmds:
rg -n 'LEFT JOIN' .
rg -n 'IS NULL' .
sqlite3 scratch.sqlite "PRAGMA table_info(users)"
sqlite3 scratch.sqlite "SELECT count(*) FROM users WHERE deleted_at IS NULL"

cards.title: Plan a JavaScript release version
cards.when: Use when deciding the next version for a JavaScript or TypeScript package before publishing.
cards.cmds:
cat package.json
git tag
npm ci

cards.title: Plan release preflight commands
cards.when: Use when planning the commands that must pass before an npm package release.
cards.cmds:
node --version
npx eslint .
npm test
npm ci
npm publish --dry-run

cards.title: Plan TypeScript release type checks
cards.when: Use when planning a TypeScript package release where compiler output and dependencies must remain compatible.
cards.cmds:
cat package.json
tsc --noEmit
prettier --check .
npm run build
npm version

cards.title: Plan release rollback and verification
cards.when: Use when planning how to restore and verify a JavaScript or TypeScript release after publishing.
cards.cmds:
git tag --list
npm pack --dry-run
npm ci
npm view --json

cards.title: Plan a SQL migration choice memo
cards.when: Use when a schema change is costly to reverse and needs a written plan before implementation.
cards.cmds:
touch docs/plan/sql-migration-choice.md
sampo decide 'partition orders by customer_id' --why 'lowest reversal cost' --rejected 'no partitioning' --revisit 'p95 over 200 ms' --kind costly

cards.title: Plan a query refactor evidence doc
cards.when: Use when a slow SQL query needs a written plan with measured evidence before rewriting.
cards.cmds:
touch docs/plan/sql-query-refactor.md
sampo decide 'add index idx_orders_customer_id' --why 'expected p95 under 100 ms' --rejected 'rewrite without index' --revisit 'p95 over 200 ms'

cards.title: Plan a safe SQL migration test doc
cards.when: Use when a SQL migration must be documented before running it on shared data.
cards.cmds:
touch docs/plan/sql-migration-safety.md
sampo decide 'apply migration to scratch database first' --why 'ON_ERROR_STOP catches failures' --rejected 'apply directly to production' --revisit 'two failed rollbacks'

cards.title: Plan SQL documentation coverage for a refactor
cards.when: Use when a SQL refactor changes schemas or queries and docs must be updated before release.
cards.cmds:
rg -g '*.sql' .
rg -g '*.md' docs
touch docs/plan/sql-docs-update.md
sampo decide 'update schema docs before release' --why 'prevents stale index guidance' --rejected 'docs after release' --revisit 'three missing examples'

cards.title: Gate Release UI Startup Time
cards.when: Use this when a C release UI binary must prove its startup time before shipping.
cards.cmds:
make release
test -x dist/ui
python3 -m timeit -s 'import subprocess' -n 1 "subprocess.run(['dist/ui', '--version'], check=True)"
date -u +"%Y-%m-%dT%H:%M:%SZ"

cards.title: Benchmark C UI Event Handler
cards.when: Use this when a C UI event handler must prove its per event cost in a release build.
cards.cmds:
cc -std=c11 -O2 -Wall -Wextra -Werror -shared -fPIC -o bench/ui_bench.so bench/ui_bench.c
test -f bench/ui_bench.so
python3 -m timeit -s 'import ctypes' -n 100000 "ctypes.CDLL('bench/ui_bench.so').handle(1)"
date -u +"%Y-%m-%dT%H:%M:%SZ"

cards.title: Shrink Release UI Binary Size
cards.when: Use this when a C release UI binary must stay small enough for fast startup and smaller downloads.
cards.cmds:
make release LDFLAGS="-Wl,--strip-all"
stat -c %s dist/ui
file dist/ui
sha256sum dist/ui

cards.title: Check Release UI Performance Regression
cards.when: Use this when a C release UI build must pass a UI latency threshold before release.
cards.cmds:
make perf-check
test -f dist/perf-report.json
jq -r 'if .p95_ms <= 50 then "pass" else "fail" end' dist/perf-report.json
date -u +"%Y-%m-%dT%H:%M:%SZ"

cards.title: Create a Python onboarding plan scaffold
cards.when: Use when onboarding a Python project and you need a plan doc before choosing tools.
cards.cmds:
mkdir -p docs/plan
touch docs/plan/decision-memo.md
ls docs/plan
cat docs/plan/decision-memo.md

cards.title: Write the onboarding decision question
cards.when: Use when onboarding a Python team and you need to state a costly choice before implementation.
cards.cmds:
touch docs/plan/decision-memo.md
cat docs/plan/decision-memo.md

cards.title: Score Python onboarding options with evidence
cards.when: Use when comparing two or more Python onboarding approaches before choosing one.
cards.cmds:
cat docs/plan/decision-memo.md
python -m pip check

cards.title: Record the Python onboarding decision
cards.when: Use when the onboarding plan has chosen one Python option and needs to document why and when to revisit.
cards.cmds:
sampo decide use-uv --why lower-maintenance --rejected pip-tools --revisit p95-over-200ms --kind costly
cat docs/plan/decision-memo.md

cards.title: Verify SQL migration against scratch database
cards.when: Use this after changing a migration file and before committing it.
cards.cmds:
psql -d postgres -c 'DROP DATABASE IF EXISTS verify_scratch'
psql -d postgres -c 'CREATE DATABASE verify_scratch'
psql -v ON_ERROR_STOP=1 -d verify_scratch -f migration.sql
psql -d verify_scratch -c "SELECT table_name FROM information_schema.tables WHERE table_schema = 'public' ORDER BY table_name"

cards.title: Verify SQL query returns one active row
cards.when: Use this when a query must hide deleted rows and return the remaining users.
cards.cmds:
psql -d verify_scratch -c "CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS users(id integer, email text, deleted_at text)"
psql -d verify_scratch -c "TRUNCATE users RESTART IDENTITY"
psql -d verify_scratch -c "INSERT INTO users(id, email, deleted_at) VALUES (1, 'a@x.io', NULL), (2, 'b@x.io', '2026-01-01')"
psql -d verify_scratch -c "SELECT email FROM users WHERE deleted_at IS NULL ORDER BY id"
psql -d verify_scratch -c "SELECT count(*) FROM users WHERE deleted_at IS NULL"

cards.title: Verify SQLite query returns one active row
cards.when: Use this when a SQLite query must hide deleted rows and return the remaining users.
cards.cmds:
sqlite3 scratch_verify.db "CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS users(id integer, email text, deleted_at text)"
sqlite3 scratch_verify.db "DELETE FROM users"
sqlite3 scratch_verify.db "INSERT INTO users(id, email, deleted_at) VALUES (1, 'a@x.io', NULL), (2, 'b@x.io', '2026-01-01')"
sqlite3 scratch_verify.db "SELECT email FROM users WHERE deleted_at IS NULL ORDER BY id"
sqlite3 scratch_verify.db "SELECT count(*) FROM users WHERE deleted_at IS NULL"

cards.title: Verify SQLite query uses an index
cards.when: Use this when a SQLite query must use an index on a scratch database.
cards.cmds:
sqlite3 scratch_verify.db "CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS users(id integer, email text, deleted_at text)"
sqlite3 scratch_verify.db "CREATE INDEX IF NOT EXISTS users_email_idx ON users(email)"
sqlite3 scratch_verify.db "DELETE FROM users"
sqlite3 scratch_verify.db "INSERT INTO users(id, email, deleted_at) VALUES (1, 'a@x.io', NULL)"
sqlite3 scratch_verify.db "EXPLAIN QUERY PLAN SELECT id FROM users WHERE email = 'a@x.io'"

cards.title: Plan Safe SQL Migration
cards.when: Use when a database migration must change schema or data before execution.
cards.cmds:
ls migrations
head -n 40 migrations/add_user_flags.sql
psql -d scratch -v ON_ERROR_STOP=1 -f migrations/add_user_flags.sql

cards.title: Check SQL Query Plan
cards.when: Use when a SQL query may be slow or need an index review.
cards.cmds:
rg 'SELECT' app/queries
cat app/queries/orders.sql
psql -d scratch -c 'EXPLAIN (ANALYZE, BUFFERS) SELECT * FROM orders'

cards.title: Validate SQL Script Syntax
cards.when: Use before executing a SQL script when parse errors must be caught early.
cards.cmds:
cat sql/orders_report.sql
psql -d scratch -v ON_ERROR_STOP=1 -f sql/orders_report.sql
test -s sql/orders_report.sql

cards.title: Plan SQL Test Seed
cards.when: Use when a SQL behavior check needs known rows before the query runs.
cards.cmds:
ls test/sql
head -n 20 test/sql/seed_users.sql
psql -d scratch -v ON_ERROR_STOP=1 -f test/sql/seed_users.sql
psql -d scratch -c 'SELECT count(*) FROM users'

cards.title: Map UI entries to one shared Python feature
cards.when: Use it when reviewing whether a web UI route calls the same shared Python function as other surfaces.
cards.cmds:
find . -name routes.py
rg -n share_feature app/web
rg -n 'def share_feature' app/core
rg -n 'def share_feature' app/web

cards.title: Run Python parity tests for the UI surface
cards.when: Use it when reviewing whether the web UI passes the same behavior tests as the other surfaces.
cards.cmds:
pytest tests/test_surface_parity.py -q
python -m pytest -q
pytest tests/test_surface_parity.py -q --tb=short
cat tests/test_surface_parity.py

cards.title: Record UI parity exceptions with clear reasons
cards.when: Use it when reviewing a feature that is absent from the web UI and needs an explicit exception.
cards.cmds:
rg -n surface_exceptions tests
cat tests/test_surface_parity.py
rg -n share_feature app/web

cards.title: Compare UI and API JSON keys for a feature
cards.when: Use it when reviewing whether the web UI and API return the same JSON keys for one feature.
cards.cmds:
jq -r 'keys[]' ui.json
jq -r 'keys[]' api.json
jq '.feature.status' ui.json
jq '.feature.status' api.json

cards.title: Verify migration script against scratch Postgres
cards.when: When checking if a SQL migration file runs without errors.

psql -d scratch_test -v ON_ERROR_STOP=1 -f migration.sql
echo $?

cards.title: Check SQLite schema loads cleanly
cards.when: When verifying a SQLite schema file has valid syntax.

sqlite3 :memory: < schema.sql
sqlite3 :memory: ".tables"
echo "Schema loaded"

cards.title: Analyze query plan with EXPLAIN ANALYZE
cards.when: When verifying a query uses the expected index.

grep "Index Scan" /tmp/explain_out
echo "Plan analyzed"

cards.title: Run baseline SQL gate before bump
cards.when: Use it right before changing a SQL toolchain or driver in a release branch.
cards.cmds:
git status
psql -v ON_ERROR_STOP=1 -h localhost -p 5432 -U release -d scratch_release -f migrations/0001_schema.sql
psql -v ON_ERROR_STOP=1 -h localhost -p 5432 -U release -d scratch_release -f tests/test_active_users.sql
git diff --stat

cards.title: Bump SQL dependency through package manager

npm install pg@8.12.0 --save
npm install
git diff -- package.json package-lock.json

cards.title: Run SQL migration on scratch database
cards.when: Use it when a dependency bump changes schema migration behavior before release.

psql -v ON_ERROR_STOP=1 -h localhost -p 5432 -U release -d migration_scratch -f migrations/0002_add_index.sql

psql -h localhost -p 5432 -U release -d postgres -c 'DROP DATABASE migration_scratch'

cards.title: Compare SQL performance against baseline
cards.when: Use it after fixing compile or query errors to confirm the upgrade did not regress the release paths.

stat -c '%s' dist/sql-client

echo 'SQL upgrade verified'

cards.title: Check UI syntax and lint

npx eslint .
npm ci

cards.title: Run UI unit tests

cat test-report.txt

find src -name "*.ts" -o -name "*.tsx"

cards.title: Find existing Rust crates for common tasks

npx playwright test tests/onboarding-targets.spec.ts

cards.title: Plan shared design tokens for Vue 3 with useCssVars
cards.when: Use this when deciding how JavaScript and CSS in a Vue 3 onboarding flow should share the same token values.
cards.cmds:
npm ls vue
find src -name 'tokens*'
npx vue-tsc --noEmit

cards.title: Map onboarding heading and body roles to type tokens
cards.when: Use this when assigning each onboarding heading, paragraph, and caption a token so the type hierarchy stays consistent.
cards.cmds:
rg -n '<h[1-6]' src/components/onboarding
rg -c '<h1' src/views
npx eslint src/components/onboarding

cards.title: Measure minified Tailwind CSS size for form page
cards.when: Use after adding form components to check that the compiled stylesheet stays within the byte budget.
cards.cmds:
mkdir -p dist
npx @tailwindcss/cli -i ./src/styles.css -o ./dist/form.css --minify
stat -c %s dist/form.css

cards.title: Confirm Lighthouse performance score for form page
cards.when: Use on a running form page to prove the performance score meets the threshold before merging.
cards.cmds:
mkdir -p reports
npx lighthouse http://localhost:3000/contact --only-categories=performance --output=json --output-path=./reports/form.json --chrome-flags=--headless
jq .categories.performance.score reports/form.json

cards.title: Check form layout shift stays under 0.1
cards.when: Use when form fields or error text may move the layout during page load.
cards.cmds:
mkdir -p reports
npx lighthouse http://localhost:3000/contact --only-audits=cumulative-layout-shift --output=json --output-path=./reports/cls.json --chrome-flags=--headless
jq -r '.audits["cumulative-layout-shift"].numericValue' reports/cls.json

cards.title: Verify input typing latency stays under 200ms
cards.when: Use when a form field runs validation or class changes on each keystroke and typing may lag.
cards.cmds:
test -f tests/form-latency.spec.ts
npx playwright install chromium
npx playwright test tests/form-latency.spec.ts

cards.title: Verify Tailwind scans form files so classes compile
cards.when: Use when a form style such as peer-invalid is missing from the built CSS even though the source uses it.
cards.cmds:
rg -l peer-invalid src/components/form
npx @tailwindcss/cli -i ./src/styles.css -o ./dist/form.css --minify
grep -c peer-invalid dist/form.css

cards.title: Inventory existing Svelte modal and form code first
cards.when: Before writing a modal form in a Svelte or SvelteKit project, to learn what already exists and which Svelte version applies.
cards.cmds:
find src -maxdepth 2 -type d
rg -n 'dialog|<form|use:enhance' src
grep -n svelte package.json
find src -iname 'modal*'
npx svelte-check --threshold error

cards.title: Choose client and server validation split for SvelteKit forms
cards.when: When a SvelteKit modal form posts data and you must decide which checks run in the browser and which run in the form action.
cards.cmds:
find src/routes -name '+page.server.*'
rg -n 'use:enhance|fail' src
rg -n 'fail\(400' src
rg -n 'length' src/lib/validation.ts
grep -n sveltekit package.json
npx vitest run

cards.title: Find expensive transition-all classes in form components
cards.when: Use before merging form components to catch transition-all, which animates every property and costs paint time.
cards.cmds:
rg -n transition-all src/components/form
sed -i -e 's/transition-all/transition-colors/g' -e 's/duration-300/duration-150/g' src/components/form/Input.tsx
rg -n transition-all src/components/form
rg -n 'duration-(2[1-9][0-9]|[3-9][0-9]{2}|[0-9]{4,})' src/components/form

cards.title: Plan golden tests for four states at two text scales
cards.when: Use this when you decide what to test before writing the button, so every state and text size is covered.
cards.cmds:
find test/widgets -name "*_test.dart"
flutter test --reporter expanded test/widgets
ls test/widgets/goldens

cards.title: Choose svelte-i18n and confirm Svelte version support
cards.when: Use this before writing form code when a Svelte project has no i18n library yet and you must pick one that fits its Svelte version.
cards.cmds:
grep -n svelte package.json
npm view svelte-i18n peerDependencies
npm view svelte-i18n version

cards.title: Plan button width for longer translated labels
cards.when: Use this when planning a submit button that must stay at least 44px tall and fit the longest translated label without clipping.
cards.cmds:
rg -n '<button' src/lib
rg -n 'min-height' src/lib
npx playwright test --list

cards.title: Animate select dropdown open and close with Transition
cards.when: Use this when a custom Vue select panel must fade and slide in and out instead of appearing and disappearing instantly.
cards.cmds:
npm ls vue
touch src/components/SelectMenu.vue
npx eslint src/components/SelectMenu.vue
npm run build

cards.title: Animate selected chips in multi-select with TransitionGroup
cards.when: Use this when a multi-select shows selected values as chips that should animate in, out, and reflow when items are added or removed.
cards.cmds:
touch src/components/SelectChips.vue
touch tests/SelectChips.spec.ts
npx vitest run tests/SelectChips.spec.ts
npm run build

cards.title: Disable select motion under prefers-reduced-motion
cards.when: Use this when select open, close, or chip animations must stop for users who set reduced motion in their operating system.
cards.cmds:
grep -rn prefers-reduced-motion src
touch tests/select-motion.spec.ts
npx playwright test tests/select-motion.spec.ts --project=chromium
npx eslint src/components/SelectMenu.vue

cards.title: Teleport select panel to body with entry animation
cards.when: Use this when the select panel must escape overflow clipping by rendering at body level while still animating open.
cards.cmds:
touch src/components/SelectPanel.vue
touch tests/select-panel.spec.ts
npx playwright test tests/select-panel.spec.ts
npm run build

cards.title: Animate highlighted option with a short CSS transition
cards.when: Use this when arrow-key navigation moves the highlighted option and the highlight should slide or fade without lagging behind the keypress.
cards.cmds:
touch tests/select-keyboard.spec.ts
npx playwright test tests/select-keyboard.spec.ts --project=chromium
npx axe http://localhost:5173

cards.title: Verify leave transition completes before unmount hooks
cards.when: Use this when focus restoration or cleanup must run only after the select panel finishes its 150ms leave animation.
cards.cmds:
touch tests/select-hooks.spec.ts
npx vitest run tests/select-hooks.spec.ts
npx vitest run

cards.title: Set the minimum tap target to 48 logical pixels
cards.when: Use this when you decide the button size for the empty and disabled states, where users still need to tap a clear target.
cards.cmds:
rg -n -e minimumSize -e tapTargetSize lib
rg -n -F "Size(48, 48)" lib
touch test/widgets/app_button_test.dart
flutter test test/widgets/app_button_test.dart

cards.title: Plan error feedback with SnackBar and inline text
cards.when: Use this when you decide how a failed action is shown to the user, both as a SnackBar and as text near the button.
cards.cmds:
rg -n -e ScaffoldMessenger -e SnackBar lib
rg -n colorScheme.error lib
touch test/widgets/error_text_test.dart
flutter test test/widgets/error_text_test.dart

cards.title: Fix the loading state width to stop layout jumps
cards.when: Use this when you plan the loading spinner, so the button does not change size when the label is replaced.
cards.cmds:
rg -n -e AnimatedSwitcher -e CircularProgressIndicator lib
rg -n -F "Duration(milliseconds: 200)" lib
flutter test test/widgets

cards.title: Inventory hard-coded form strings before choosing keys
cards.when: Use this at the start of an i18n form task to list every user-visible string in the Svelte form components.
cards.cmds:
grep -n svelte package.json
rg -l '<form' src
rg -c '<label' src
wc -l docs/i18n-strings.txt
npx svelte-check --threshold error

cards.title: Plan message keys for each field and error
cards.when: Use this when designing message keys so every form field has a label, placeholder, and error text with stable names.
cards.cmds:
rg -n 'name=' src/lib
jq -r 'keys[]' src/lib/i18n/locales/en.json
jq 'keys | length' src/lib/i18n/locales/en.json
npx svelte-check --threshold error

cards.title: Plan ICU plural messages for length-limit errors
cards.when: Use this when a form field has a character limit and the error text must agree with the count in every language.

rg -c 'plural' src/lib/i18n/locales/en.json
rg -c 'plural' src/lib/i18n/locales/de.json
npx svelte-check --threshold error

grep -n func Sources/ChartPerf/ChartDataDownsampler.swift
xcodebuild test -scheme ChartPerf -destination platform=macOS -only-testing:ChartPerfTests/DownsampleTests

touch Sources/ChartPerf/ChartView.swift
xcodebuild build -scheme ChartPerf -destination platform=macOS
xcodebuild test -scheme ChartPerf -destination platform=macOS -only-testing:ChartPerfTests/ChartEquatableTests

cards.title: Rasterize dense marks with drawingGroup in Charts

xcodebuild test -scheme ChartPerf -destination platform=macOS -only-testing:ChartPerfTests/ChartRenderPerfTests
stat Sources/ChartPerf/ChartView.swift

cards.title: Render only the visible window in a scrollable chart

xcodebuild test -scheme ChartPerf -destination platform=macOS -only-testing:ChartPerfTests/VisibleWindowTests

xcodebuild test -scheme ChartPerf -destination platform=macOS -only-testing:ChartPerfTests/AxisDomainTests

grep -c '{:else}' src/lib/components/onboarding/EmptyChecklist.svelte

npm run build
npx vitest run src/lib/components/onboarding
